head: e11a86db623a0babcd713e3d32b97341b6cad1b8

symptom.provider_result: Director MiniMax-M3 returned 7 native write_file calls successfully, but TransactionKernel rejected the atomic batch before effects.

root_cause.mechanism: _normalize_task_contract preserved every concrete target_file but truncated merged scope_items to _PM_CONTRACT_SCOPE_PATH_LIMIT=6, so R115's seventh declared Rust target lost authority. Independent review then found the same invariant could drift again after autofix_pm_contract_for_quality added task-local target_files without updating scope_paths. The Director gateway and JobToken correctly derive write authority from the final scope_paths; atomic batch preflight correctly denied the unauthorized target and prevented all seven writes.
root_cause.security_boundary: The DEO policy and atomic batch behavior are correct and must not be weakened.
root_cause.required_invariant: At the final PM contract boundary, every task-local concrete target_file must be covered by an exact or parent scope_path from that same task. The six-item compact limit may constrain only supplementary non-target scopes, never declared or autofix-added mutation targets.

fix.initial_normalization: Retain every task-local concrete target_file in scope_paths; apply the compact budget only to supplementary scopes.
fix.final_contract_boundary: After quality autofix, reconcile every task independently using the same exact-or-parent path semantics as DEO and append only uncovered task-local targets.
fix.least_privilege: No project-level target union, no DEO relaxation, no partial batch application, and an existing parent directory scope remains sufficient without redundant widening.

forbidden_fixes: allow partial application of an invalid atomic tool batch
silently drop target_files beyond the scope limit
required_tests: A normalized task with more than six target_files retains all targets in scope_paths.
A real Card3D quality autofix that adds build/test targets leaves every final target covered by the same task's exact-or-parent scope.
An existing parent directory scope remains sufficient and is not expanded to project-wide authority.
A real wrong-path write remains denied by DEO policy.
Existing PM adapter suite remains green.

red_test.result_before_fix: 1 failed: every declared task target must remain inside that task's capability scope

focused_after_fix: 2 passed: explicit >6 target regression plus real Card3D post-autofix reconciliation
137 passed: complete PM adapter pure suite
242 passed: directed-effect public authorization/policy plus adapter production wiring, policy snapshot, and mutation port
wide_after_fix: KernelOne release gate ok=true: 415 passed, 1 skipped, 2 warnings
static_after_fix: ruff format: two touched files already formatted

post_edit_codegraph_review.observed_flow: _normalize_task_contract -> quality autofix -> final exact-or-parent target/scope reconciliation -> role request metadata/context -> derive_role_turn_capability_scope -> RoleToolGateway/JobToken -> directed-effect policy

independent_review.summary: Final boundary covers all post-autofix tasks, appends only task-local targets not already covered by exact or parent scope, matches DEO directory semantics, and does not broaden project authority or weaken fail-closed behavior.
